title: Pool protocol v1 message: error (router -> coordinator)
description: A dispatched job failed. stage=pre_token enables hop-on-error (automatic re-dispatch within the same class, D-G1); stage=mid_stream is a clean, client-visible, structured error (D-G2). Anti-memory: message is capped at 200 chars and must never include prompt/response content (D-I1).

stage.description: pre_token = failed before the first response token (hop eligible, D-G1); mid_stream = failed after the first token (D-G2).

code.description: model_gone: serving model vanished; overflow: context overflow (carries the canonical "exceeds the available context size" wording, D-C5); crash: engine crashed; timeout: deadline exceeded; client_disconnected: client gave up (D-G4); other: anything else.

message.description: Short, non-sensitive reason. Must NEVER include prompt/response content (anti-memory, D-I1); capped at 200 chars.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt tokens consumed before the failure, or null if unknown.

response_tokens.description: Partial response tokens generated before the failure, if any; null otherwise.

conv_key.description: Continuity key (64 hex) of the affected conversation, or null if unknown.

t_queued_ms.description: Time from intake to dispatch start, in ms; null if unknown.

t_service_ms.description: Time from dispatch start to failure, in ms; null if unknown.
